title: Urgent patch: private deployment RBAC/SAML mapping bypass and KMS audit gaps
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Multiple customers running Redwood Private reported two related failures after a configuration change: 1) SAML assertion role-mapping sometimes produced empty role sets which allowed fallback to a default admin role in the RBAC layer; 2) KMS-integrated key rotation events were not emitted to our audit pipeline for some private control-plane installs, leaving operators blind to recent symmetric key replacements. Both issues together create a risk of unintended privilege escalation without reliable audit trails. This ticket coordinates an urgent patch, targeted backport to supported private versions, and customer communications. Scope: private control plane (VPC), on-prem bundles; verify Dedicated if shared code paths are affected.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:20 - SEV raised by Support (TCK-16248) after Acme Payments reported admin access granted after SSO login. Initial triage by on-call found correlation with a recent IdP metadata refresh.

2026-03-12 11:05 - Reproduced locally with a crafted SAML assertion missing <Attribute Name="roles">. Our role-mapper returned an empty list and RBAC layer treated empty==allow due to legacy behavior. Root cause: role-mapper returns null vs empty array; RBAC evaluator defaults to 'allow' for null path (bug introduced in 2025-11 refactor).

2026-03-12 14:30 - Temporary mitigation: feature-flagging rollout: set PRIVATE_STRICT_RBAC=true in affected installs to treat null as deny. Ops applied to 3 highest-priority customers. Documented mitigation in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private/rbac-mitigation-2026-03

2026-03-12 17:20 - Separate audit gap discovered: KMS key rotation handler failed to emit audit.log events when the control plane is configured with third-party KMS proxy. Missing log path around kms/rotate -> audit/emit (race condition introduced during async refactor).

2026-03-13 08:50 - Patch branches created: git+github.com/redwood-inference/private-control-plane@fix/rbac-null-deny-ENG-8931 and git+github.com/redwood-inference/private-control-plane@fix/kms-audit-emit-ENG-8931. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-control-plane/pull/1286 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-control-plane/pull/1287

2026-03-13 12:10 - Diego: added unit tests for SAML attribute parsing + integration test that exercises idp metadata refresh. Also added e2e KMS rotation test that asserts audit message present in syslog and forwarded to external SIEM (ElastiSIEM test harness).

2026-03-13 15:40 - PM (Janelle Rios) drafted customer notification. Support running targeted notifications to impacted accounts (Acme, Nimbus Health, BeaconEd). Support ticket IDs: TCK-16248, TCK-16251, TCK-16259.
2026-03-14 09:00 - Security review kickoff scheduled: security@redwood review of patches and threat model. Link to short writeup: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private/incident-ENG-8931

2026-03-14 11:30 - QA: staging bundle built and smoke-tested in private-staging region. No regression on SSO SLOs observed. Performance impact: <0.5% added latency on SSO handshake measured in synthetic tests. Monitoring dashboards created: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/ENG-8931
2026-03-14 13:15 - Rollout plan: canary to 2 customers by 2026-03-15, broader rollout to on-prem customers with managed assistance 2026-03-16..2026-03-18. Rollback plan documented in PRs and runbook.
